query: Do federal judges appointed by different Presidents (Trump vs. other Republican vs. Democratic) differ in their voting tendencies on immigration injunction cases? Do Trump-appointed judges tend to be more supportive of Trump administration immigration policies compared to judges appointed by other Republican or Democratic presidents?

schema.name: judge_name
schema.definition: The full name of the federal judge presiding over the case or issuing the opinion.
schema.rationale: Necessary to identify the specific judge and subsequently determine their appointing President.

schema.name: appointing_president
schema.definition: The name of the U.S. President who appointed the judge to the federal bench.
schema.rationale: Directly addresses the core query comparing Trump appointees, other Republican appointees, and Democratic appointees.

schema.name: appointing_president_party
schema.definition: The political party of the President who appointed the judge.
schema.rationale: Allows grouping of judges by political party (Democratic vs. Republican) to analyze voting tendencies.

schema.name: case_type
schema.definition: The legal category of the case, specifically identifying if it is an immigration injunction or related immigration policy challenge.
schema.rationale: Ensures the case falls within the scope of 'immigration injunction cases' specified in the query.

schema.name: challenged_policy_administration
schema.definition: The presidential administration that enacted or implemented the challenged immigration policy.
schema.rationale: Helps determine if the judge's ruling supports or opposes policies of a specific administration (e.g., the Trump administration).

schema.name: ruling_direction
schema.definition: The outcome of the judge's ruling relative to the government's immigration policy (e.g., ruling in favor of the government/policy or in favor of the immigrant/plaintiff challenging the policy).
schema.rationale: Directly measures the judge's 'voting tendency' and supportiveness toward administration policies.

schema.name: injunction_granted
schema.definition: Whether the judge granted the requested preliminary or permanent injunction against the government's immigration policy.
schema.rationale: Directly answers whether the judge ruled to halt/enjoin the immigration policy in question.

observation_unit.name: Judge
observation_unit.definition: A federal judge whose voting tendencies on immigration injunction cases are analyzed based on the appointing President.
